description: BUNCH 5: Polish + Quality + Admin Refresh - admin refresh button, empty states, session cleanup, TS fixes, steering file update
steps: Add admin 'Refresh Questions' button in import-dashboard.tsx (which renders on /admin/import page): Button labeled 'Reload Questions from Server' that calls fetch('/api/imported-questions') then stores in localStorage ('cfa-buddy-imported-questions'). Shows toast or inline message: '1,000 questions loaded successfully'. Shows current count: 'Currently loaded: X questions'.

Add empty states: If no imported questions loaded yet (localStorage empty and API returns empty), show friendly message: 'No questions loaded. Click Reload Questions or run the import script.' If starting a session with 0 available questions in selected filters, disable start button and show 'No questions match your filters'.

Implement session cleanup: Auto-delete sessions older than 30 days from localStorage on app load. Keep max 50 sessions (delete oldest beyond that). Add this logic to session-storage.ts and call it from the questions page or a layout effect. This prevents localStorage from bloating.

Fix any TypeScript errors from previous bunches: Run npx tsc --noEmit and fix ALL errors (ignoring prisma client pre-existing). Run npm run lint and fix ALL warnings. Run npm run build and ensure it succeeds.

Update .kiro/steering/project-state.md: Mark Bug #1 (imported questions not loading) as FIXED. Update features table with new additions (Mock Exam, Subject Selection, AdaptiveRetest, WeakTopic, Timer, Navigation Grid, Keyboard Shortcuts, Review Dashboard enhancements). Add note: '1,000 questions available via /api/imported-questions'.
Git commit with message: feat: admin refresh, empty states, session cleanup, polish
acceptance_criteria: Admin import page has Reload Questions button that fetches and stores questions
Shows count of currently loaded questions
Empty state message shown when no questions available
Start button disabled when filters yield 0 questions
Session cleanup removes sessions >30 days old and keeps max 50
project-state.md updated with fixed bugs and new features
findings: Had to exclude prisma/, src/generated/, and src/shared/lib/prisma/ from tsconfig.json to fix the pre-existing prisma type errors that were blocking next build. Used useState lazy initializer for localStorage read in import-dashboard to avoid the react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint error. All 3 verification commands pass cleanly.
